pr_title: windows_firewall_rule: Fix idempotency and add icmp_type property
pr_body:
This PR contains several things, which are described in the linked issues.

## Description
- icmp_type (new property): this type is always needed, when a protocol starts with ICMP (default value "Any"). 
- description (change property) : this property is not needed for creating a firewall rule. When updating a standard default windows firewall rule, the description is always updated, even when not necessary. So the default value will be removed.
- add validation for protocol + icmp_type during action :creation
- add tests for group and icmp_type
- add examples to windows_firewall_rule out of the current docs

## Related Issue
closes #9542
closes #9543 
closes #9546

issue_context.title: windows_firewall_rule always overrides description even when not necessary
issue_context.body:
## Description
When I want to update a windows firewall rule with my specified properties, which do not contain any description in it, the description should not be updated.
Right now, this is the behavior, which should be changed by removing the property default of descriptiion.

## Chef Version
16.0.*

## Platform Version
Windows

## Replication Case
Update any existing firewall rule. It will always set 'Firewall rule' in the description, when no other value is present.

## Client Output
not necessary

## Stacktrace
not necessary

Traditionally we stick this above the actions.

I would agree with that, but as I have tested this, it's not possible to move it out of the `action_class` block.
So it is in the same block like we have right now in the `locale` resource (https://github.com/chef/chef/blob/master/lib/chef/resource/locale.rb#L81)

```
          case icmp_type
          when Integer
            protocol.start_with?("ICMP") && (0..255).include?(icmp_type)
          when String
            # string logic
          else
            false
          end

```

Like others have mentioned, this code could likely be simplified for more clarity.

I would have filled in the string logic but it was more complicated than I realized and felt like more work than it was worth trying to fix in a github comment box. :)
